## Findings
- claim-1: **Block lemma.** Let \(M\in\mathbb Z^{R\times C}\), with finite ordered sets \(C=B\sqcup D\), and let \(P\subseteq R\), \(|P|=|D|\). Put \[ A=M[P,B],\qquad U=M[P,D]\in GL_{|D|}(\mathbb Z). \] If each \(r\in R\setminus P\) satisfies \[ M[r,B]=M[r,D]U^{-1}A, \] then the rows indexed by \(P\) generate the complete row lattice of \(M\). The Smith diagonal of \(M\) has exactly \(|D|\) nonzero entries, all equal to \(1\), and \(\mathbb Z^C/\operatorname{row}_{\mathbb Z}(M)\) is freely generated by the images of the \(B\)-coordinate vectors.
## Strategy
The requested block lemma is established. Write \(A=M[P,B]\), \(U=M[P,D]\). Since \(U\in GL_{|D|}(\mathbb Z)\), \(U^{-1}\) is integral. For \(r\notin P\), put \(q_r=M[r,D]U^{-1}\). The hypothesis gives
\[
M[r,B]=q_rA,\qquad M[r,D]=q_rU,
\]
hence \(M[r,C]=q_r\,M[P,C]\). Thus selected rows generate the complete row lattice.

The unimodular column operation
\[
W=\begin{pmatrix}I_B&0\\-U^{-1}A&U^{-1}\end{pmatrix},
\qquad \det W=\det(U^{-1})=\pm1,
\]
sends the selected block to
\[
[A\ U]W=[0\ I_{|D|}],
\]
and sends every unselected row to \(0\). Hence the Smith diagonal has exactly \(|D|\) nonzero entries, all \(1\).

Explicitly, define
\[
\pi:\mathbb Z^B\oplus\mathbb Z^D\to\mathbb Z^B,\qquad
\pi(x_B,x_D)=x_B-x_DU^{-1}A.
\]
The selected rows lie in \(\ker\pi\), and if \(\pi(x_B,x_D)=0\), then
\[
(x_B,x_D)=(x_DU^{-1})[A\ U],
\]
so \(\ker\pi=\operatorname{row}_{\mathbb Z}(M)\). Therefore
\[
\mathbb Z^C/\operatorname{row}_{\mathbb Z}(M)\cong\mathbb Z^B,
\]
with the original \(B\)-coordinate classes as a free basis.

For \(D=\varnothing\), the condition forces \(M=0\), giving no Smith entries and quotient \(\mathbb Z^B\). For \(B=\varnothing\), the quotient is \(0\) and all \(|D|\) Smith entries are \(1\). The doubly empty case is included.

## Gaps
This proves only the abstract block lemma. It does not supply the separate degreewise \((2,2,4,4)\) indexed minors or residual computations.

## Next
A separate computation certificate would need explicit \(B_d,D_d,P_d,U_d\), determinants, and zero residual vectors in each required degree.
